description: Choose two Druid cantrips. Choose one level 1 Druid spell; you always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability. Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose with a different Druid spell of the same level.
name: Magic Initiate (Druid)
